sections.title: A Proactive Approach to Cost Optimization
sections.body: Many AI startups feel 'locked in' to expensive cloud providers due to the perceived complexity of infrastructure migration. Kenya AI Compute eliminates this barrier by providing dedicated migration support. We use industry-standard orchestration tools like Kubernetes, Terraform, and Docker, making our infrastructure compatible with the environments you are already running on AWS or Google Cloud. The process begins with a 'Cloud Health Check,' where our architects analyze your current resource utilization and build a mirrored environment in our Kenyan facility. We utilize secure data transfer tunnels to sync your datasets and provide a 7-day parallel run period to verify performance and latency. Our goal is to make your move to $0.70/GPU-hour as effortless as a simple API endpoint update. sections.title: The Migration Workflow
items: Infrastructure Audit: We map your current cloud dependencies and resource needs.
Mirror Setup: We deploy your stack on our GPU/CPU clusters for testing.
Data Sync: Secure, high-bandwidth transfer of your training datasets and weights.
Validation: Performance benchmarking to ensure our hardware meets or exceeds your current cloud.
Seamless Cutover: Updating your DNS or API routes to our low-latency IP transit.
